{{Quote|Lady, if you had wings, I could fly ''you''.|Ronto to Sigel Dare|<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>}}
'''Ronto''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> During the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] in [[137 ABY]], Ronto's [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] was destroyed, but not before the pilot [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejected]] into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> He managed to enter the [[Dac/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and land safely, but he was captured by forces of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. During [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s subsequent [[Massacre of New Coral City]], Ronto and several other Alliance pilots were released from [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] by fellow Rogue [[Monia Gahan]] and by the [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]], servants of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="Legacy 22" />

Under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Drok]], Ronto helped sabotage the defenses of the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] in preparation for the [[Evacuation of Dac]] after Krayt's [[One Sith]] released [[viral spore]]s into the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. The [[Poison/Legends|poison]] would [[Genocide on Dac|purge]] Dac of all life, which prompted Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and an [[emergency evac fleet]] to race against [[Time/Legends|time]], but they were only able to evacuate twenty percent of Dac's population.<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>

In [[138 ABY]], Darth Krayt began a renewed military push against the newly-formed [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]] of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, the Empire-in-exile, and the [[New Jedi Order]], a campaign that proved to be the endgame of the war. Ronto was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the final [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] of the conflict, the Alliance's [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-occupied [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Legacy War 6" />
